description: Store a key/value pair in your private sidecar memory. Prerequisite: none — memory is agent-local, no world state or lot membership required. Effect: the sidecar keeps `value` under `key` in its in-memory map for the remainder of this sidecar process's lifetime; a subsequent recall(key) on the same sidecar returns the same value. A second remember on the same key overwrites the prior value (last-writer-wins). Cost: none in real seconds or motive. NOT persistent across bot or sidecar restart — this scope intentionally ships without disk persistence; when experiments show the lack bites, a follow-up item will add durable storage. NOT a FreeSO wire action — memory has no PDU, does not cross the lot socket, and is invisible to other Sims (use `speak` to publish to other Sims on the lot). Values are stored verbatim as JSON; recall returns the same shape the agent sent (object, array, string, number, bool, null).

args.name: key
args.description: Non-empty key to store under. Keys are per-sidecar, not namespaced — choose keys distinct enough to avoid collisions with other memories (e.g. 'friend:maria', 'goal:eat', not 'x').

args.name: value
args.description: The value to store. Any JSON value: string, number, boolean, null, object, or array — the sidecar stores the argument verbatim. Recall returns the same shape the agent sent. Must be present (even as null) — a missing value arg is rejected with ok=false.
